subject: Senior hire triage and backfill play for QBR prep
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Senior hire triage and backfill play for QBR prep

Team —

QBR is 10 days out; running the OKR check-ins this week and want to lock headcount asks so the revenue/ops slides align. Attached is a concise playbook (QBR_headcount_plays_v1.xlsx) with three prioritized reqs and recommended decisions. High-level: 

- Req A: Senior Infra Engineer (backfill) — blocker for infra reliability OKR, 1:1 replacement.
- Req B: Staff ML Infra (new, high-CPU/low-latency work) — strategic but +20% run-rate.
- Req C: Senior Sales Engineer (replacement) — important for near-term deals, can be deferred 6–8 weeks if we extend cover.

Proposal (decision needed by EOD Wed):
1) Approve Req A as immediate backfill (hire).
2) Escalate Req B to exec review for conditional hire if we can defer other contractor spend (seek partial offset).
3) Freeze Req C to Q3 unless a deal requires an immediate ramp (we can provide SE coverage via contracting).

Asks: please reply with any objections or approval and any quick numbers (cost delta / ops offset) you need. I've also flagged TalentOps (external) to run a fast-sourced slate in parallel if we get approval.

Notes: the sheet includes a decision matrix and time-to-fill projections. Link to the working doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBRHeadcountPlays.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_headcount_plays_v1.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior hire triage and backfill play for QBR prep

>

>

> - Req B: Staff ML Infra (new, high-CPU/low-latency work) — strategic but +20% run-rate.
> - Req C: Senior Sales Engineer (replacement) — important for near-term deals, can be deferred 6–8 weeks if we extend cover.

Thanks Soojin — solid framing. Quick responses: 

- Approve Req A (Senior Infra) as a backfill hire. This role directly ties to the SLO remediation objective; cost is justified.
- Req B (Staff ML Infra): I will greenlight conditional approval if Product/Applied ML can confirm a hiring-offset plan (contractor reduction or scope deferral). I need a short cost delta doc — I attached a quick estimate (cost_delta_staff_ml_v2.pdf).
- Req C (Senior SE): Freeze for Q2; we keep vendor/contractor coverage and revisit in the May OKR refresh.

Logistics: if we approve Req A now, please route to HiringOps and mark as priority for the pipeline (recruiter + TalentOps). Also, I'd like a one-slide justification for the exec QBR (50–75 words) summarizing impact to OKRs.

-L

Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachments: cost_delta_staff_ml_v2.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, TalentOps <talentops@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Senior hire triage and backfill play for QBR prep

Thanks Laura — appreciate the quick turn.

Action summary (I will update the spreadsheet and the exec slide):
- Req A (Senior Infra): APPROVED. Routing to HiringOps + TalentOps for immediate sourcing. Target: 6–7 week fill. Attachment: recruiting_timeline_talentops.docx (draft).
- Req B (Staff ML Infra): CONDITIONAL. Rishi / Applied ML: can you confirm contractor offsets or a reduced-scope plan by Tue EOD so we can push this into the exec ask? Laura's cost delta attached is the baseline.
- Req C (Senior SE): FREEZE Q2. We'll extend contractor cover and flag to RevOps for deal coverage.

For the exec slide I propose: "Approve a prioritized backfill for Senior Infra Engineer to secure infra SLOs; defer non-critical sales headcount to Q3 and evaluate Staff ML Infra conditional on offsetting spend." I'll draft the 50–75 word blurb and post to the Drive.

Looping TalentOps (external) to confirm they can run a fast slate if HiringOps marks Req A red. TalentOps: can you confirm a 4-week active sourced slate + 2-week buffer?

Thanks — Soojin
